Subject: Discovery recap — GreenLeaf Analytics / Redwood (decision horizon)

Hi Liam / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today — good conversation and a helpful window into GreenLeaf's ingestion volume and retention constraints. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock on timing: 

Recap (high level)
- Primary use case: real-time summary + in-product search over large telemetry sets (~8–12 TB/month).
- Key constraints: PII redaction at ingest, 30-day hot KV cache, and a sub-200ms 95th percentile response for short queries.
- Success metric: reduce token cost per query by ~40% while keeping per-query latency <200ms.

Proposed next steps
1) Short technical sync (30 min) — walkthrough of integration pattern + KV/cache options.
2) Pilot scope doc — I'll share a one-pager (low lift) with measurable SLAs and data handling notes.
3) Timing check — are you evaluating this for an August pilot or later in Q4? Any internal approval windows I should know about?

I attached my notes from today and a 15-minute demo/architecture deck. If it helps, Marissa can join the technical sync to cover onboarding and support model.

Availability: I have openings next week (Mon/Tue 11–2 PT) or the week after (Wed/Thu mornings). What works best for you?

Thanks,

— Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
